command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0078/probe.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: The four 0.49.0 rows: 32-bit mov with a SIB index, both directions at disp8 and disp32. There is no prefix byte, so ModRM is byte 1 (register [11,3]) and SIB is byte 2 (scale [22,2], index [19,3], base [16,3]); the displacement follows at [24,8] or [24,32]. The disp8 rows are four bytes (8b 44 08 08, 8b 7c b7 08, 89 44 08 08, 89 7c b7 08) with %rsp and %rbp as SIB bases (8b 44 0c 08, 8b 44 35 08), and the disp32 rows are seven. input_sha256 is probe.asm; output_sha256 is the 63-byte .text.
